title: Prove frozen old-owner exclusion and marked-store refusal without losing pending writing

decisionTitle: Keep old-owner lifecycle controls discriminating against actual native and format guards
decision: Do not mistake pending cleanup locks for an opening or the setup-busy screen for a marked-store refusal. Assert the existing active-owner exclusion first. Queue the frozen native reader behind the real current owner, then close all current app tabs for the complete old artifact’s marked-store unlock. Keep an inert observer and byte-identical protected-data digest, an independently authenticated marker/parser control, and exact current cold writing. Test-only asset controls retain the packaged MIME/CSP boundary and never touch APIs.
